newsitem.title: ROMANIA: SOCCER-ROMANIA LOSE TWO KEY PLAYERS FOR IRELAND MATCH.
newsitem.headline: SOCCER-ROMANIA LOSE TWO KEY PLAYERS FOR IRELAND MATCH.

text.p: Romania will be without experienced midfielders Gheorghe Popescu and Ionut Lupescu for their World Cup qualifier against Ireland this month.
Popescu, who plays for Barcelona, is out with a leg injury while Lupescu is refusing to play after spending almost all of Romania's recent match against Lithuania on the substitutes' bench.
Popescu said he had been told to rest after straining a muscle in a league match last week.
"Doctors told me after a check-up the next day that I have a three-centimetre muscle rupture and I have to stay out for at least 10 days," he told Reuters by telephone from Spain.
Lupescu, of German side Borussia Moenchengladbach, said he would not play in the match in Bucharest on April 30 because he was brought on for only three minutes against Lithuania.

"I cannot agree to spending my time on the national team's bench," Lupescu said by telephone from Germany. "Romania has almost qualified for the 1998 World Cup finals so I think my contribution is no longer very important."
Both players were leading members of the Romanian "dream team" which beat Colombia, the United States and Argentina to reach the quarter-finals of the 1994 World Cup.
Romania have won all five of their qualifying matches for the 1998 World Cup finals in France and Popescu is the leading scorer in the European groups with eight goals.
National coach Anghel Iordanescu is due to name his 20-man squad for the Ireland match next week. REUTER
